dct_description_sm: The focus of this multi-year project was to establish a water temperature monitoring program in the Ta'an Kwach'an Council (TKC) Traditional Territory in order to collect baseline data and to develop temperature trends for predicting possible increase in temperature with the changing climate. The main objectives of the project were: (1) collect long term data on thermal regimes of freshwater ecosystems within the TKC Traditional Territory; (2) collect traditional knowledge of local water ecology; (3) build capacity within TKC and throughout the territory; and (4) collect data pertinent to a regional monitoring program of the Yukon River Basin.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Ecological Monitoring of Freshwater Thermal Regimes in the Ta'an Kwach'an Council Traditional
